title: Access review: reviews
purpose: Keep the laboratory's signed access reviews, in which a reviewer decided for each grant an account holds whether to keep it or remove it, open one, and export them. For holders of the review capability only.
summary: The laboratory's signed access reviews, newest first: which accounts each covered, how many grants were reviewed and decided for removal, and who signed it.

tasks.title: Record an access review
steps: Choose the accounts, decide Keep or Remove for every grant, enter your password and select Sign access review.

tasks.title: Open an access review
steps: Select its number, such as AC-000001, to see every decision, whether each grant decided for removal is still held, and the sign-off.

tasks.title: Keep a copy of the access reviews
steps: Select [[Export CSV]]. The file holds every access review listed, one row each, with its checksum.

good_to_know: An access review records decisions. It removes nothing: a superuser removes the grant on the account's page in the admin console.
A signed access review cannot be changed or removed, by you or anyone else.
There is no interval, due date or reminder for access reviews. The laboratory decides when to record one.
Each page you open here, each access review you open and each export is recorded, and other reviewers see it under Workspace use in [[Audit review]].

sections.title: The Reviews tab
paragraphs: The third tab of Access review, after Accounts and Unused accounts and before Emergency access. An access review is the laboratory's signed record that a reviewer went through every grant the chosen accounts held and decided, for each one, to keep it or remove it, with findings, follow-up and the reviewer's sign-off. Which accounts to review, how often and what to do about a removal stay the laboratory's choice.
Nothing on this tab changes an account. Notes cannot be added to an access review, and it has no second approver.

items.label: Access review
items.description: The access review's number, such as AC-000001, given when it is signed, in the order signings commit. Select it to open the access review.

items.label: Accounts reviewed
items.description: Staff accounts, Client portal accounts, or Client portal accounts of one organization, with how many accounts it listed below.

items.label: Grants
items.description: How many grants the access review listed, each with a decision.

items.label: Decided to remove
items.description: How many of them the reviewer decided to remove. Shown muted when none.

items.label: Signed by
items.description: The signer's name, and below it the roles they held when they signed, as kept with the access review.

items.label: Signed
items.description: The date and time of the signing, in the laboratory's time zone, by the application's clock.

items.label: Record an access review
items.description: Opens the page that lists the grants of the accounts you choose and records your decisions and sign-off in one step. Also offered when no access review exists yet.

items.label: No access review recorded yet
items.description: Shown instead of the table until the first access review is signed.

items.label: Pages
items.description: Fifty access reviews per page, newest first. Every page, and the export, lists the access reviews as they stood when the first page opened, so one signed since does not move a row. Open the tab again from the menu to see it.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: A spreadsheet file of every access review listed, one row each: Access review, Accounts reviewed, Accounts, Grants, Decided to remove, Findings, Follow-up, Signed by, Username, Roles, Meaning, Signed at (with its offset) and SHA-256 checksum. The decisions are not in it: export them from the access review's page. Shown when 1 to 10,000 access reviews are listed. A cell that a spreadsheet would read as a formula starts with an apostrophe.

sections.title: Who can use this page
paragraphs: Staff with a laboratory role who hold the capability Can review access and audit records, as for the rest of Access review and the Audit review workspace. The admin role alone is not enough, and client portal accounts are refused. Everyone who may open the tab can record an access review and read every one.

Each page of this list and each export is recorded under Workspace use in Audit review, with the source Access review: reviews, the page after the first and how many access reviews were listed. If the record cannot be written, nothing is shown or exported. Signing an access review is recorded as a change, listed under Changes as Access review signed.
